latest_cos_commentary.headline: Card Market is a small gift-card printing and fulfillment provider partnering with POS companies and resellers to serve restaurants and retailers.
latest_cos_commentary.genius_exposure: Competes narrowly on loyalty_engagement's gift-card fulfillment component — a back-end print/fulfillment vendor rather than a software or payments platform competitor.
latest_cos_commentary.competitive_timing: No recent news or funding found in this pass.
latest_cos_commentary.sales_response: Relevant only if a prospect's gift-card program uses Card Market for physical card fulfillment; not a POS/payments comparison point.
latest_cos_commentary.risk_and_uncertainty: Very limited public information; appears to be a small, low-visibility vendor.
